summary_1line: Debate on wealth versus renunciation: ascetic knowledge leads to liberation, yet a king is urged to use wealth for sacrifice and righteous duties.

image_candidates.scene_text: A forest ascetic sits motionless in meditation as a tortoise withdraws its limbs beside a quiet forest pool, symbolizing the withdrawal of desires.
King Marutta performs a grand sacrifice where every vessel is made of gold and the goddess Sree appears amid blazing ritual fires.
Indra stands radiant in heaven after lavish sacrifices, surrounded by gods and heaps of offered treasures.
